camera_motor.map: t_motor = a * t_camera_host + b   (Arduino micros in host perf_counter base)
camera_motor.fitted_to: serial motor events only; never to attitude residuals

imu_motor.fitted_to: gyro rate domain vs commanded rate; camera never used

estimator.grid: uniform resample at the median sample interval, mapped back
estimator.provenance: parameters unchanged from the established yaw method in analysis/yaw/yaw_vv_master_analysis.py
estimator.status: SECONDARY DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - never replaces the RAW finite difference and is never labelled a RAW accuracy

conditioning.relative_attitude_note: frames before the zero reference is established carry a valid absolute pose but no relative attitude
